files.GIT10BF.EXEC:
/* M10 bounded side-band pkt-line state machine. */
parse upper arg cmd hex extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 'ERASE G10META DATA A'
 call putmeta 'HDR','-',0,'-'
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 'EXEC GITPBUF INIT'
 exit rc
end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 work=hex
 do while work\=''
  if phase='HDR' then do
   need=8-length(hdr)
   take=length(work)
   if take>need then take=need
   hdr=hdr||left(work,take)
   work=substr(work,take+1)
   if length(hdr)<8 then iterate
   call pktlen hdr
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   n=result
   hdr=''
   if n=0 | n=1 | n=2 then iterate
   if n<5 then exit 8
   remain=n-4
   phase='BAND'
  end
  else if phase='BAND' then do
   if length(work)<2 then do
    say 'GIT10BF: odd internal band byte'
    exit 8
   end
   band=left(work,2)
   work=substr(work,3)
   remain=remain-1
   if band\='01' & band\='02' & band\='03' then exit 8
   if band='03' then exit 8
   if remain=0 then phase='HDR'
   else phase='PAY'
  end
  else if phase='PAY' then do
   bytes=length(work)%2
   take=bytes
   if take>remain then take=remain
   if take>64 then take=64
   if band='01' & take>0 then do
    'EXEC GITPBUF APPEND' left(work,take*2)
    if rc\=0 then exit rc
   end
   work=substr(work,take*2+1)
   remain=remain-take
   if remain=0 then do
    phase='HDR'; band='-'
   end
  end
  else exit 8
 end
 call putmeta phase,hdr,remain,band
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FINAL' then do
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 if phase\='HDR' | hdr\='' then do
  say 'GIT10BF: incomplete pkt-line at FINAL'
  exit 8
 end
 'EXEC GITPBUF FINAL'
 exit rc
end
exit 4
getmeta:
 drop m.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR G10META DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | m.0\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 parse var m.1 tag phase h remain band extra
 if tag\='META' | extra\='' then return 'ERROR'
 if h='-' then hdr=''
 else hdr=h
 return 'OK'
putmeta:
 parse arg p,h,r,b
 if h='' then h='-'
 m.1='META' p h r b; m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW G10META DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
pktlen: procedure
 parse arg h
 n=0
 do i=1 to 4
  b=x2d(substr(h,i*2-1,2))
  if b>=48 & b<=57 then v=b-48
  else if b>=65 & b<=70 then v=b-55
  else if b>=97 & b<=102 then v=b-87
  else return 'ERROR'
  n=n*16+v
 end
 return n
files.GIT10PK.EXEC:
/* M10A incremental Git side-band PACK feeder. */
parse upper arg cmd hex extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 if hex\='' then exit 4
 'EXEC GITPBUF INIT'
 exit rc
end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 do while hex\=''
  if length(hex)<8 then exit 8
  call pktlen substr(hex,1,8)
  if result='ERROR' then exit 8
  n=result
  if n=0 then do
   hex=substr(hex,9)
   iterate
  end
  if n<5 then exit 8
  bytes=n-4
  need=n*2
  if length(hex)<need then exit 8
  data=substr(hex,9,bytes*2)
  band=substr(data,1,2)
  if band='01' then do
   p=substr(data,3)
   do while p\=''
    take=length(p)%2
    if take>64 then take=64
    h=substr(p,1,take*2)
    'EXEC GITPBUF APPEND' h
    if rc\=0 then exit rc
    p=substr(p,take*2+1)
   end
  end
  else if band='02' then nop
  else if band='03' then do
   say 'GIT10PK: remote fatal side-band'
   exit 8
  end
  else exit 8
  hex=substr(hex,need+1)
 end
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FINAL' then do
 if hex\='' then exit 4
 'EXEC GITPBUF FINAL'
 exit rc
end
exit 4

pktlen: procedure
 parse arg h
 n=0
 do i=1 to 4
  b=x2d(substr(h,i*2-1,2))
  if b>=48 & b<=57 then v=b-48
  else if b>=65 & b<=70 then v=b-55
  else if b>=97 & b<=102 then v=b-87
  else return 'ERROR'
  n=n*16+v
 end
 return n
files.GIT10UP.EXEC:
/* M10 bounded upload-pack response parser. */
parse upper arg cmd hex extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 'ERASE G10CMT DATA A'
 call putmeta 'PRE','HDR','-',0,'-'
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 'EXEC GIT10BF INIT'
 exit rc
end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 work=hex
 do while work\=''
  if phase='HDR' then do
   need=8-length(hdr)
   take=length(work)
   if take>need then take=need
   hdr=hdr||left(work,take)
   work=substr(work,take+1)
   if length(hdr)<8 then iterate
   call pktlen hdr
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   n=result
   if n=0 | n=1 | n=2 then do
    hdr=''
    iterate
   end
   if n<4 then exit 8
   remain=n-4
   if state='PACK' then do
    'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' hdr
    if rc\=0 then exit rc
    hdr=''
    phase='PASS'
   end
   else do
    prehdr=hdr
    hdr=''
    pre=''
    phase='PREPAY'
   end
  end
  else if phase='PASS' then do
   bytes=length(work)%2
   take=bytes
   if take>remain then take=remain
   if take>64 then take=64
   if take>0 then do
    'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' left(work,take*2)
    if rc\=0 then exit rc
   end
   work=substr(work,take*2+1)
   remain=remain-take
   if remain=0 then phase='HDR'
  end
  else if phase='PREPAY' then do
   bytes=length(work)%2
   take=bytes
   if take>remain then take=remain
   if take>5 then take=5
   pre=pre||left(work,take*2)
   work=substr(work,take*2+1)
   remain=remain-take
   if length(pre)>=2 & left(pre,2)='01' then do
    state='PACK'
    call passpre prehdr,pre
    if result='ERROR' then exit 8
    pre=''
    if remain=0 then phase='HDR'
    else phase='PASS'
   end
   else if length(pre)>=2 &,
      (left(pre,2)='02' | left(pre,2)='03') then do
    state='PACK'
    call passpre prehdr,pre
    if result='ERROR' then exit 8
    pre=''
    if remain=0 then phase='HDR'
    else phase='PASS'
   end
   else if remain=0 then do
    if pre\='4E414B0A' then do
     say 'GIT10UP: unexpected pre-PACK pkt-line'
     exit 8
    end
    pre=''
    phase='HDR'
   end
  end
  else exit 8
 end
 if phase='PREPAY' then hdr=prehdr
 call putmeta state,phase,hdr,remain,pre
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FINAL' then do
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 if state\='PACK' | phase\='HDR' | hdr\='' then exit 8
 'EXEC GIT10BF FINAL'
 exit rc
end
exit 4
passpre:
 parse arg h,p
 'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' h||p
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
getmeta:
 drop m.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR G10CMT DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | m.0\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 parse var m.1 tag state phase h remain p extra
 if tag\='META' | extra\='' then return 'ERROR'
 if h='-' then hdr=''
 else hdr=h
 if phase='PREPAY' then do
  prehdr=hdr
  hdr=''
 end
 if p='-' then pre=''
 else pre=p
 return 'OK'
putmeta:
 parse arg s,ph,h,r,p
 if h='' then h='-'
 if p='' then p='-'
 m.1='META' s ph h r p; m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW G10CMT DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
ascii4:
 parse arg n
 s=right(d2x(n),4,'0')
 out=''
 do i=1 to 4
  p=pos(substr(s,i,1),'0123456789ABCDEF')-1
  if p<10 then out=out||d2x(48+p,2)
  else out=out||d2x(55+p,2)
 end
 return out
pktlen: procedure
 parse arg h
 n=0
 do i=1 to 4
  b=x2d(substr(h,i*2-1,2))
  if b>=48 & b<=57 then v=b-48
  else if b>=65 & b<=70 then v=b-55
  else if b>=97 & b<=102 then v=b-87
  else return 'ERROR'
  n=n*16+v
 end
 return n
files.GIT11HTP.EXEC:
/* M11D bounded HTTP response parser and body router. */
parse upper arg cmd hex mode extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 route=hex
 if route='' then route='FILE'
 if route\='FILE' & route\='GIT' then exit 4
 call putmeta 'HEAD','',route
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 if route='FILE' then 'ERASE M11BODY DATA A'
 else do
  'EXEC GIT10UP INIT'
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
 end
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if mode\='' | extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 work=hex
 do while work\=''
  if state='BODY' then do
   call body work
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   work=''
  end
  else do
   b=left(work,2)
   work=substr(work,3)
   tail=tail||b
   if length(tail)>8 then tail=right(tail,8)
   if tail='0D0A0D0A' then do
    state='BODY'
    tail=''
   end
  end
 end
 call putmeta state,tail,route
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FINAL' then do
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 if state\='BODY' then exit 8
 if route='GIT' then do
  'EXEC GIT10UP FINAL'
  exit rc
 end
 exit 0
end
exit 4
body:
 parse arg h
 do while h\=''
  n=length(h)
  if n>128 then n=128
  piece=left(h,n)
  h=substr(h,n+1)
  if route='GIT' then do
   'EXEC GIT10UP FEED' piece
   if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  end
  else do
   q.1=piece
   q.0=1
   'EXECIO 1 DISKW M11BODY DATA A 0 (STEM Q. FINIS'
   if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  end
 end
 return 'OK'
getmeta:
 drop m.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR M11META DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | m.0\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 parse var m.1 tag state tail route extra
 if tag\='META' | extra\='' then return 'ERROR'
 if tail='-' then tail=''
 return 'OK'
putmeta:
 parse arg s,t,r
 if t='' then t='-'
 m.1='META' s t r
 m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW M11META DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
files.GIT12CHK.EXEC:
/* M12I bounded HTTP/1.1 chunk decoder. */
parse upper arg cmd hex mode extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 route=hex
 if route='' then route='FILE'
 if route\='FILE' & route\='GIT' then exit 4
 call putmeta 'SIZE','',0,route
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 if route='FILE' then 'ERASE M12BODY DATA A'
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FEED' then do
 if mode\='' | extra\='' | hex='' | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 4
 hex=translate(hex)
 if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 work=hex
 do while work\=''
  if state='SIZE' then do
   b=left(work,2)
   work=substr(work,3)
   line=line||b
   if length(line)>32 then exit 8
   if right(line,4)='0D0A' then do
    hs=left(line,length(line)-4)
    if hs='' | verify(hs,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 8
    need=0
    do j=1 to length(hs) by 2
     v=x2d(substr(hs,j,2))
     if v>=48 & v<=57 then n=v-48
     else if v>=65 & v<=70 then n=v-55
     else if v>=97 & v<=102 then n=v-87
     else exit 8
     need=need*16+n
    end
    line=''
    if need=0 then state='DONE'
    else state='DATA'
   end
  end
  else if state='DATA' then do
   avail=length(work)%2
   take=need
   if take>avail then take=avail
   piece=left(work,take*2)
   work=substr(work,take*2+1)
   call body piece
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   need=need-take
   if need=0 then state='CRLF'
  end
  else if state='CRLF' then do
   b=left(work,2)
   work=substr(work,3)
   line=line||b
   if length(line)=4 then do
    if line\='0D0A' then exit 8
    line=''
    state='SIZE'
   end
  end
  else if state='DONE' then work=''
  else exit 8
 end
 call putmeta state,line,need,route
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 exit 0
end
if cmd='FINAL' then do
 call getmeta
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 if state\='DONE' then exit 8
 exit 0
end
exit 4
body:
 parse arg h
 if h='' then return 'OK'
 if route='GIT' then do
  'EXEC GIT10UP FEED' h
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 else do
  q.1=h
  q.0=1
  'EXECIO 1 DISKW M12BODY DATA A 0 (STEM Q. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'
getmeta:
 drop m.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR M12CMETA DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | m.0\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 parse var m.1 tag state line need route extra
 if tag\='META' | extra\='' then return 'ERROR'
 if line='-' then line=''
 return 'OK'
putmeta:
 parse arg s,l,n,r
 if l='' then l='-'
 m.1='META' s l n r
 m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW M12CMETA DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'

files.GIT9CTX.EXEC:
/* M9P bounded context: one data file plus sequential index. */
parse upper arg cmd key oid n otype extra
address command
if cmd='INIT' then do
 'ERASE G9CIDX DATA A'
 'ERASE G9CDATA DATA A'
 'ERASE G9CMETA DATA A'
 r.1='NEXT 1 0'; r.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW G9CMETA DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
 exit rc
end
if cmd='SAVE' then do
 if extra\='' | datatype(key,'W')\=1 | datatype(n,'W')\=1 then exit 4
 if otype='' then otype='BLOB'
 drop r.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR G9CMETA DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | r.0\=1 then exit 8
 parse var r.1 word start idxrec
 if word\='NEXT' | datatype(start,'W')\=1 then exit 8
 if datatype(idxrec,'W')\=1 then idxrec=0
 off=0; nrec=0
 /* Copy validated object records directly in bounded 16-record batches. */
 /* Avoid one nested REXX EXEC per 64-byte record during SAVE. */
 drop om.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITOMETA DATA A 1 (STEM OM. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | om.0\=1 then exit 8
 parse var om.1 otag osize otail ofinal oextra
 if otag\='META' | osize\=n | otail\='-' |,
  ofinal\='1' | oextra\='' then exit 8
 do while off<n
  first=off%64+1
  batch=(n-off+63)%64
  if batch>16 then batch=16
  drop r.
  'EXECIO' batch 'DISKR GITOBUF DATA A' first,
   '(STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 | r.0\=batch then exit 8
  do j=1 to batch
   h=strip(r.j)
   expected=n-off-(j-1)*64
   if expected>64 then expected=64
   if length(h)\=expected*2 |,
    verify(h,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 8
   r.j=h
  end
  'EXECIO' batch 'DISKW G9CDATA DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then exit 8
  nrec=nrec+batch
  off=off+batch*64
 end
 r.1=key oid n otype start nrec; r.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW G9CIDX DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 r.1='NEXT' start+nrec idxrec+1; r.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW G9CMETA DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
 exit rc
end
if cmd='LOADPOS' | cmd='LOADOID' then do
 rec=1; found=0
 if cmd='LOADPOS' then do
  drop z.
  'EXECIO 1 DISKR G9CMETA DATA A 1 (STEM Z. FINIS'
  if rc=0 & z.0=1 then do
   parse var z.1 ztag znext zcount
   if ztag='NEXT' & datatype(zcount,'W')=1 & zcount>0 then do
    rec=zcount
    do while rec>0 & \found
     drop r.
     'EXECIO 1 DISKR G9CIDX DATA A' rec '(STEM R. FINIS'
     if rc\=0 | r.0\=1 then leave
     parse var r.1 p o sz typ first count
     if p=key then found=1
     else if p<key then leave
     else rec=rec-1
    end
   end
  end
  if found then rec=0
  else rec=1
 end
 do while \found
  drop r.
  'EXECIO 1 DISKR G9CIDX DATA A' rec '(STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 | r.0=0 then leave
  parse var r.1 p o sz typ first count
  if (cmd='LOADPOS' & p=key) | (cmd='LOADOID' & o=key) then found=1
  rec=rec+1
 end
 if \found then exit 8
 'ERASE GITBASE DATA A'
 /* Read and copy contiguous base records in bounded 16-record batches. */
 i=0
 do while i<count
  batch=count-i
  if batch>16 then batch=16
  drop q.
  src=first+i
  'EXECIO' batch 'DISKR G9CDATA DATA A' src,
   '(STEM Q. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 | q.0\=batch then exit 8
  'EXECIO' batch 'DISKW GITBASE DATA A 0 (STEM Q. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then exit 8
  i=i+batch
 end
 m.1='META' sz '- 1'; m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITBMETA DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 queue p
 queue o
 queue sz
 queue typ
 exit 0
end
exit 4
